identificationModule.briefTitle: A Trial of NS/GEMOX Chemotherapy in Patients With Untreated Pancreatic Cancer ( HZ-NS/GEMOX-PC )
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II , Open-label , Investigator-initiated Trail of Sequential GEMOX/NS Chemotherapy in Patients With Untreated Pancreatic Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
This is a Phase II , Open-label , Investigator-initiated Trail of Sequential GEMOX/NS Chemotherapy in Patients With untreated Pancreatic cancer.

This study aims to evaluate the safety and efficacy of Sequential GEMOX/NS Chemotherapy as a first-line treatment of untreated Pancreatic cancer.

armGroups.label: Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Albumin-binding paclitaxel+S1 / gecitabine+oxaliplatin Interchanged every 2 cycles

interventions.name: Albumin-bound paclitaxel
interventions.description: Albumin-bound paclitaxel is paclitaxel formulated as albumin-bound nanoparticles with a mean particle size of approximately 130 nanometers.

interventions.name: S-1
interventions.description: a combination preparation of tegafur, gimeracil, and oteracil potassium

interventions.name: Oxaliplatin
interventions.description: The compound features a square planar platinum(II) center. In contrast to cisplatin and carboplatin, oxaliplatin features the bidentate ligand 1,2-diaminocyclohexane in place of the two monodentate ammine ligands. It also features a bidentate oxalate group.

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: Gemcitabine is a synthetic pyrimidine nucleoside prodrug-a nucleoside analog in which the hydrogen atoms on the 2' carbon of deoxycytidine are replaced by fluorine atoms.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the first drug administration up to 6 months
from the first drug administration up to 1 year
